questions.prompt: Why is Anna not going away this summer?
questions.evidence: This summer I am too busy.
questions.explanation: too busy 是今年夏天不能度假的直接原因。她明明喜欢夏季和海滩；原文也没有说她去过所有海滩。
options: She has already visited every beach.

spokenEvidence.quote: This summer I am too busy.

questions.prompt: What do Anna and Amelia plan to do first in their programme?
questions.evidence: First, we’re going to introduce the subject.
questions.explanation: First 标明第一步是介绍主题。展示图片视频在 Then 之后；读问题在 Finally 之后，所以不能仅因这些活动都在计划里就选错顺序。

spokenEvidence.quote: First, we’re going to introduce the subject.

questions.prompt: How can children take part in the programme?
questions.explanation: Kids can ask us questions 表示儿童可以向主持人提问。游乐设施是介绍的度假活动，不是参与节目的报名条件；也没有要求孩子们一起出国。
answers: They can ask the presenters questions.
options: They can ask the presenters questions.
They must buy tickets for rides.
They must travel abroad with the presenters.

questions.prompt: Which activities does Amelia enjoy when camping?
questions.evidence: When I go camping, Anna, I like to go hiking and fishing.
questions.explanation: Amelia 明确列出 hiking 和 fishing，即徒步与钓鱼。其他选项即使也是可能的休闲活动，也没有在这句中出现。

spokenEvidence.quote: When I go camping, Anna, I like to go hiking and fishing.

questions.prompt: Where can visitors go on rides and eat fun food? Write TWO WORDS for the type of place.
questions.evidence: At an amusement park, you go on rides and eat lots of fun food!
questions.explanation: 原句把 rides 和 fun food 与 amusement park 联系起来，意思是游乐园。题目要求两个词，填 amusement park，不加 an；beach 和 camping 是另外两种活动。

spokenEvidence.quote: At an amusement park, you go on rides and eat lots of fun food!

questions.prompt: What makes Anna want to leave the city immediately?
questions.evidence: When I see that blue ocean, I want to leave Washington, D.C. immediately and go to the beach!
questions.explanation: When 引出触发这个想法的情境：看到蓝色大海。她随后仍要回去工作，节目也没有取消，所以不能把想度假当成已经完成工作或真的出发。
options: Hearing that the programme is cancelled.

spokenEvidence.quote: When I see that blue ocean, I want to leave Washington, D.C. immediately and go to the beach!
